title: Tenant reservation slab mapping and utilization probe - Q1 2027
body:
Summary:
This sheet is a working probe of per-contract "slab" reservations across regions. 'Slabs' are 8-GPU contiguous reservation blocks (mixed-T4, A10G, A100 depending on region) allocated to Dedicated customers under committed contracts. The goal is to produce a short-term retiling plan that reduces idle hours while preserving committed throughput for each contract through the next 8 weeks.

Key assumptions:
- Slab = 8 GPUs. Fractional slabs are allowed (1 slab = 8 GPUs, 0.5 slab = 4 GPUs) for scheduling only; billing follows contract terms.
- Regions considered: us-west1, us-east4, eu-west1, ap-southeast1.
- GPU families: T4 (cost-efficient), A10G (general purpose), A100-80GB (high-throughput).
- Utilization target for reserved slabs is 55% steady-state; anything below 35% triggers retiling action.
- Peak buffer: keep N+1 slabs for contracts with >200 inferred qps on production routes.

Table: reservation slabs per contract (next 8 weeks snapshot)
ContractID,Customer,Region,GPU_Family,Reserved_Slabs,Avg_Weekly_RunHours,Observed_Util_pct,Peak_Week_Slabs,Carryover_Slabs,Notes
C-8121,ParcelAI,us-west1,A100-80GB,12,960,68,14,0,High sustained; permissive burst to 14 for weekend inference spikes
C-9092,AcmeDocs,us-east4,A10G,6,312,42,6,1,Mid-week heavy embed jobs cause Monday ramp; 1 slab carryover to absorb bursts
C-7704,ByteSurvey,eu-west1,T4,3,120,28,3,0,Low steady usage; flagged for retiling (util < 35%)
C-6340,HealthLoop,us-west1,A10G,8,540,51,9,0,N+1 policy applies (sensitive latency SLA)
C-9415,FinLedger,eu-west1,A100-80GB,10,820,61,12,2,Committed high throughput, regional redundancy requirement: +2 carryover
C-5523,ShopSmart,ap-southeast1,A10G,4,184,36,4,0,Seasonal traffic; monitor 3-week trend
C-2201,EdifyLabs,us-east4,T4,2,56,19,2,0,Low utilization; candidate for conversion to on-demand or fractional pooling
C-3847,GeoMap,us-west1,T4,5,210,39,5,0,Edge routing improvements may improve utilization by 8-12%

Interpretation and flags:
- Low-util contracts (util < 35%): C-7704, C-2201. These are primary candidates for retiling. Options: (a) convert to shared fractional pool with soft-guarantee, (b) schedule nightly batch windows to increase run-hours, (c) offer contract amendment with reduced committed slabs.
- Peak buffer overshoot: ParcelAI and FinLedger require temporary slab increases during known peak windows. Ensure we have cross-region fallback (e.g., finledger eu->us warm standby).
- Carryover slabs indicate committed billing exposure without near-term consumption (FinLedger has 2 carryover slabs). Finance should be looped for customer credit considerations.

Scenario variants (what-if):
- 10% regional capacity pressure (capacity drops due to node maintenance in us-west1): target retiling moves contracts on T4 -> A10G fractional mixture; expected increase in token latency for T4-sensitive routes.
- 15% new committed demand (one customer expands): we prioritize A100 families to high-throughput customers (FinLedger/ParcelAI) and suggest convert low-util T4s to pooled capacity.

Action items (owner, ETA):
- Re-tiling pilot: move C-7704 (3 T4 slabs) into pooled fractional schedule for 4 weeks and monitor util (owner: Diego Martinez, ETA: 2027-02-22).
- Finance review: propose short credit arrangement for C-9415 2 carryover slabs (owner: Priya Nair, ETA: 2027-02-18).
- Ops runbook update: add N+1 enforcement checks and automated reclamation workflows for util < 25% persisting 3 weeks (owner: Samir Patel, ETA: 2027-03-05).
- Observability: add per-contract token-level cost telemetry for slab vs on-demand delta (owner: Avery Chen, ETA: 2027-02-28).

Quick forecast (8-week consolidated):
- Total reserved slabs across tracked contracts: 50 slabs (400 GPUs).
- Expected average utilization across these reserved slabs: 46% -> target after actions: 55%.
- Forecasted reclaimable slabs if retiling executed: 6 slabs (48 GPUs) convertible to pooled capacity.

Notes and open questions:
- Confirm contractual constraints on fractional billing for ParcelAI and FinLedger (legal may require SLA amendment).
- Check whether on-prem/backplane maintenance windows for eu-west1 are scheduled in week 6 (possible conflict with proposed retiling window).
- Should we offer customers a "seasonal pool" add-on to avoid billing churn? Draft upsell pricing in next doc.

Revision history:
- 2026-11-22: initial probe sheet created (Avery Chen)
- 2026-12-14: added ParcelAI peak buffer analysis (Diego Martinez)
- 2027-02-15: updated observed utilization with Jan-Feb telemetry, added action items (Avery Chen)
